title: At the Beach
description: Three short recordings about a day at the beach: sand, ice cream and a swim.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Sand and sun
parts.intro: You will hear Lily and her dad.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: Look, Dad! The sea is big.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Yes, Lily. Put on your hat. The sun is hot.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: Where is my bucket? Is it in the red bag?

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: No, it's in the blue bag.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: Can I make a sandcastle?

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Yes. I will help you. We can fly the kite later.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: Dad, the sand is very hot. I like it, but my feet are warm.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Wear your sandals, then. Let's walk to the water. It's a lovely day.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: I'm so happy, Dad. I love the beach.

parts.title: Part 2 · Ice cream
parts.intro: You will hear Nam and his mum.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Mum, I want an ice cream.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: What flavour? Strawberry or banana?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Banana, please.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Look! I see a crab. It is small and red.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Don't touch it, Nam.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Mum, the ice cream is cold and sweet. It is very good.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Eat it slowly, Nam. Then we can walk on the sand.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: OK, Mum. This is a nice day.

parts.title: Part 3 · A swim
parts.intro: You will hear a boy called Tom.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: I love the beach. I swim in the sea with my sister.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: We see three fish. My sister finds a pink shell.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Then we eat sandwiches under the umbrella. After lunch we go home.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: My sister and I like the beach very much. The water is cool.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: It is a fun day, and we are very happy.

questions.text: What does Dad say Lily must put on?

questions.explanation: Dad says the bucket is in the blue bag.
Lily asks to make a sandcastle. The kite is for later.
Yes. He says "I will help you."

questions.text: Which ice cream does Nam want?

questions.explanation: Nam says he sees a small red crab.

questions.text: How many fish do they see?
questions.explanation: Tom says they see three fish.
The sister finds a pink shell.
They eat sandwiches under the umbrella.
